channel.title: The GW Hatchet - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The GW Hatchet (gwhatchet.com)

item.title: First-generation students launch podcast to aid transition to college life
item.description: A group of first-generation students, with the help of a GW staff member, launched a podcast to share resources on college applications and the transition to university life for prospective students who are first in their families to attend college.

item.title: Extended restaurant week offers lifeline as rising costs squeeze DC dining scene
item.description: Restaurant owners say the extension of Metropolitan Washington Restaurant Week has helped recoup lost revenue and offered a financial buffer as rising food prices, labor costs and federal immigration enforcement strain D.C. 's dining industry.

item.title: CLRE unveils earlier, staggered housing registration after years of student complaints
item.description: Students said they think separating freshman and sophomore registration from upper class registration may allow the University to finalize housing assignments sooner than in previous years.

item.title: GWPD staffing surged 20 percent since August as department works to combat turnover: officials
item.description: The GW Police Department staffing increased by 20 percent since August, officials confirmed, after struggling with consistent vacancies and high turnover rates.

item.title: GW renames Diversity Summit amid Trump DEI crackdown, student concerns over rollbacks
item.description: GW has renamed its annual Diversity Summit to the OneGW Summit and broadened its focus from solely diversity, amid federal scrutiny of DEI efforts.

item.title: Students say GW must choose a ‘side of history’ after failing to stand against Trump-era policies
item.description: Students said Trump’s administration is targeting vulnerable communities, and by not directly condemning these actions, officials are signaling a lack of support for communities under direct attack.

item.title: Community warns potential FY2027 budget cuts will jeopardize GW’s academic mission
item.description: Community members said another year of cutbacks tacked on to this year’s reduced budget would thwart GW’s ability to fully support its students and maintain its academic mission.

item.title: GW’s pending deal with UHS will bring stability back to MFA, experts say
item.description: Universal Health Services' looming deal with GW over the Medical Faculty Associates reflects what healthcare experts say was likely the only viable option for the University to return the medical enterprise to stability and end its financial support.

item.title: Epstein files include message from then-GSEHD dean
item.description: The files contain a LinkedIn message from then-Dean of the Graduate School of Education and Human Development Michael Feuer to Epstein around early January 2013.

item.title: Experts preview upcoming DC mayor race
item.description: On this episode of Getting to the Bottom of It, reporters Maddie Flesch and Aadarshini Vijesh speak with a GW professor and a District journalist about what GW community members can expect as the 2026 mayoral race heats up. This podcast was hosted and produced by Max Porter and Lizzie Jensen.
